description: Reopen r-sort-3-keys-accdb (ACCDB) read-only. Reads the rows that survived the one-INSERT-per-row loads into LU, LU2, LU3 (S, ID) and NP1..NP10 (K, N) and NS and NSC; walks the four NS indexes; and for LK, LK2, FR, LU, LU2, LU3, NP1..NP10, NS and NSC enumerates every index (Name, Primary, Unique, Foreign, Required, IgnoreNulls, DistinctCount, field names and attributes). Asks actual uniqueness and Null-inclusion behaviour of long compound keys, the Null-option combinations the API admits (a refused property creation is in the NP9 and NP10 create results of the fixture probe), and which logical indexes the engine reports for aliased columns.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
